title: User profile schema
description: Schema for a single user profile object (NOT a meta-wrapped config file). The profile stores information needed by the L4 care-recommendation layer to rank facilities. PRIVACY: This profile MUST NOT store age, date of birth, name, contact information, or precise location. Age band is collected per-session via the 'age_band' slot, not stored in the profile. home_area is area-level only (planning region name) — precise addresses, postal codes, and coordinates are prohibited. visit_history is recorded only when consent.visit_history is true. All four consent fields are independent; all except 'service' default to false.

chas_note.description: Optional free-text note about CHAS status. The schema does NOT hardcode CHAS sub-categories (Blue/Orange/Green) to avoid staleness as policies change.

home_area.description: Area-level location only (e.g. a Singapore planning region name). Storing precise addresses, postal codes, or coordinates is PROHIBITED.

use_current_location.description: Whether the session may use the current device location. Location is used only for the current calculation and is NOT persisted.

visit_history.description: Past facility visits. Recorded ONLY when consent.visit_history is true.

questionnaire_answers.description: Keys are question ids; values are either a single option id (string) or an array of option ids (for multi-select questions).

computed_weights.description: Keys are level_ids where weights are used (SEE_DOCTOR_24_48H, BOOK_SOON). Values are objects mapping feature ids to numeric weights (0–1). The sum of weights for each level MUST be 1; feature ids MUST exist in the features array of weight_presets. These cross-field constraints are checked by the downstream validation script, not by JSON Schema.

visited_month.description: Year-month only (e.g. 2026-03). Day-level precision is NOT stored to protect privacy.

service.description: Consent to use data for the core triage service.

followup_contact.description: Consent to be contacted for follow-up.

research_use.description: Consent to use anonymised data for research.

visit_history.description: Consent to record facility visit history.

consent.description: All four consent flags are independent. service is required; the other three (followup_contact, research_use, visit_history) default to false.
